bc_generational_pressure.definition: An expectation that one generation passes to the next about when life should happen.
bc_generational_pressure.example: Generational pressure rarely sounds like a command; it sounds like an observation.

flutter.definition: To move your wings quickly but not very far. A fluttering bird stays in the same place.
flutter.example: Wren fluttered on the branch until her wings ached.

generative_ai.definition: AI that produces new content such as text, images, audio or code, rather than only sorting or labelling.
generative_ai.example: Drafting the email was the easiest part of the job this week.

wh_earth_wire.definition: The green-and-yellow conductor that ties the metal case of an appliance to the earth bar in the board.
wh_earth_wire.example: The earth wire was cut by a drill during the last renovation.

wild_animal.definition: An animal that lives on its own in nature, not with people.
wild_animal.example: A tiger is a wild animal. We must keep far away from it.
